0022600132.text: The Heat come into this game 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, sitting 15th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, two games back, while the Hawks are 2-1, first in the Southeast and third in the East. Atlanta are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Miami are 0-1 on the road while Atlanta are 2-0 at home... The two teams have not met yet this season, and Miami won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026.
